usage: agentbreeder [-h] [--version]
                    {validate,doctor,example,quickstart,deploy,status,remove,forward,list,approve,reject,approve-call,reject-call,disable,enable,reconcile,audit,build,eval,release,registry,secret,services,promote,cluster,up,login,migrate,logs,next,new}
                    ...

Local development: validate, gate and deploy trusted HTTP containers. The
identity gate runs at deploy time; status and reconcile re-verify principals.
Opt-in runtime enforcement covers MCP Streamable HTTP tool calls through the
egress sidecar only.

positional arguments:
  {validate,doctor,example,quickstart,deploy,status,remove,forward,list,approve,reject,approve-call,reject-call,disable,enable,reconcile,audit,build,eval,release,registry,secret,services,promote,cluster,up,login,migrate,logs,next,new}
    validate            Validate a deploy manifest or an agent file (kind:
                        agent)
    doctor              Check local Docker prerequisites without changes
    example             Copy a shipped example project (`example list` shows
                        them)
    quickstart          Build, gate, deploy, invoke and remove the sample
                        (needs Docker)
    deploy              Gate and deploy a manifest
    status              Show a deployment and re-verify its principal
    remove              Remove a deployment
    forward             Open a loopback port to a Kubernetes deployment
    list                List deployments that are not removed (read-only, no
                        IdP calls)
    approve             Approve a pending approval as a second person
    reject              Reject a pending approval as a second person
    approve-call        Approve one held MCP tool call as a second person
    reject-call         Reject one held MCP tool call as a second person
    disable             Persist a principal blocker and stop its workloads
    enable              Clear a principal blocker (starts nothing)
    reconcile           Re-verify principals and retry blocked cleanup
    audit               Inspect and verify the local audit chain
    build               Build an agent file into an image and a deploy
                        manifest (never deploys)
    eval                Run an agent's eval set against a running endpoint
    release             Build, deploy a candidate, run the eval gate, promote
                        the exact image if it passes
    registry            Author and inspect registry versions
    secret              Manage local secret files (secret:// refs)
    services            Local backing services from stack.yaml (local-only
                        preview)
    promote             Deploy the released image to Kubernetes, without
                        rebuilding it
    cluster             A local kind cluster for one stack (preview)
    up                  Start the local command center on 127.0.0.1 (single
                        user, preview)
    login               Sign in with the operator's OIDC device flow
    migrate             Upgrade the local state to this version's schema (no
                        IdP calls)
    logs                Show the saved log tail of the last failed release
                        candidate
    next                Show where this project is on the guided path and the
                        command to run next
    new                 Write a starter project (`new agent NAME`)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
